gloss: to wake up; to come to one's senses

definitions.gloss: to wake up; to open one's eyes
definitions.explanation: To transition from sleep to wakefulness.

definitions.gloss: to come to one's senses; to snap out of it
definitions.explanation: To realize the truth of a situation or abandon an illusion or misguided course of action.

examples.english: I woke up at 6 in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物音|ものおと}→物音：03633_monooto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{目|め}を{覚|さ}ますこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I sometimes wake up from a noise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夜中|よなか}→夜中：01008_yonaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{目|め}を{覚|さ}ます⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧だ。
examples.english: The baby wakes up many times during the night, so I'm sleep-deprived.

examples.japanese: ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧かげん{目|め}を{覚|さ}ませ。
⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{目|め}を{覚|さ}ました。
examples.english: My friend's words made me come to my senses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧ようやく{目|め}を{覚|さ}まし、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甘|あま}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: After experiencing failure, I finally came to my senses and realized my own naiveté.

notes:
A common expression with both literal (waking up) and figurative (coming to one's senses) meanings. The verb ⟦{覚|さ}ます→覚ます：02057_samasu⟧ means "to awaken" (transitive), so {目|め}を{覚|さ}ます literally means "to awaken one's eyes."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Intransitive use: ⟦{目|め}が{覚|さ}める→目が覚める：23498_megasameru⟧ — to wake up (spontaneous; eyes open on their own)
- Transitive use: {目|め}を{覚|さ}ます — to wake (oneself) up / to awaken someone
- Causative: {目|め}を{覚|さ}まさせる — to make someone wake up / come to their senses
- ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧{目|め}を{覚|さ}ます — to wake up early in the morning
- 〜⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{目|め}を{覚|さ}ます — to wake up because of ~
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧かげん⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|さ}ませ→覚ます：02057_samasu⟧ — snap out of it already (imperative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧ — to get up (more general; includes getting out of bed)
- ⟦{目覚|めざ}める→目覚める：04649_mezameru⟧ — to awaken (literary/formal equivalent)
- ⟦{我|われ}に{返|かえ}る→我に返る：17406_warenikaeru⟧ — to come to oneself (figurative only; more dramatic)
